scripts.build:packages: npm run generate -w @evidara/database && npm run build -w @evidara/contracts -w @evidara/ontology -w @evidara/connectors-sdk -w @evidara/reporting -w @evidara/database
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @evidara/api & npm run dev -w @evidara/web & npm run dev -w @evidara/connector-worker & npm run dev -w @evidara/ai-worker & wait
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:bootstrap: npm run migrate:deploy -w @evidara/database && node scripts/create-bucket.mjs && npm run seed -w @evidara/database
scripts.dev:workers: npm run dev -w @evidara/connector-worker & npm run dev -w @evidara/ai-worker & wait
